purpose: Teach: 附帯/インテリジェンス/ウェブページ/所信/タイマー/ハンディ/モデリング/クリアー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、附帯条件を丁寧に交渉された
lines.en: When you were starting the company, you negotiated the terms so carefully.
lines.style: Gentle reminiscence. Warm respect threading through each phrase. Steady pace, like settling into a familiar memory. Slight pause before each item — giving weight to what was done right.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはインテリジェンスを重視された
lines.en: Yes. You always valued intelligence and insight.
lines.style: Clear acknowledgment. Respectful, but grounded — not flowery. Even tone, steady eye contact. Speaking to the past as if it's still present in the room.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、ウェブページ初期に投資された
lines.en: You invested in the website early, when others wouldn't have.
lines.style: Soft, almost marveling. Long breath on the opening. Quiet amazement at the foresight. Trailing off slightly at the end — the weight of how far ahead he was.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの所信表明は社員を奮い立たせた
lines.en: Yes. The conviction you shared in that early message rallied the whole team.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate. Speaking to something that still echoes. Slight emphasis on 「所信」 — the power of leadership that comes from clarity, not volume. Warmth underneath the composure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、工場ラインのタイマー精度にこだわった
lines.en: You were meticulous about the precision of those factory timers — wouldn't let it slide.
lines.style: Quieter, almost tender. The tone of someone who watched someone care deeply about invisible details. Slight shake of the head — admiration mixed with the memory of that stubbornness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは早期にハンディ端末を導入された
lines.en: Yes. You were ahead of everyone, bringing in those handheld terminals when the industry wasn't ready.
lines.style: Steady respect. Not surprised by this — it fits the pattern he's been describing. Voice carries the weight of knowing how much that choice mattered, in hindsight. Calm conviction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、ビジネスモデリングを自ら作られた
lines.en: You built the business model yourself — didn't wait for someone else to figure it out.
lines.style: Hushed. The cumulative weight of all these memories landing here. Slow pace. Each word deliberate. The voice of someone understanding, all at once, the scope of what was done alone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは難題を次々とクリアーされた
lines.en: Yes. You solved one hard problem after another. That's what I remember most.
lines.style: Quiet, final. This is the summation — not loud, but absolute. Deep in the register. The kind of voice that closes a door gently and locks it. This is what legacy is.
